gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding reduced from GBP 254.547m at the opening of the year to GBP 245.286m at year end. Prior-year development produced an overall gross release of approximately GBP 17.1m (around 6.7% of opening reserves), driven by benign/favourable claims development across Syndicate 1861 (notably Primary Excess of Loss and Single Job Construction) and a reduction in reinsurance recoveries and associated bad debt provisions. A material and separate exposure remains from Syndicate 340 in respect of the 11 September 2001 World Trade Center terrorist attacks, which continues to be reserved on scenario/probability-weighted assumptions.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) derived from the gross claims development table which only discloses a single underwriting-year column (2011). Movement computed as the change in the 2011 column between the '36 months later' and '48 months later' rows (347,848 -> 330,725 = -17,123k). Narrative net figures (e.g. net favourable movement GBP 12.695m) are present but were not used as a primary source because the requirement is for GROSS PYD. The claims triangle is limited (only 2011 shown) due to transitional disclosure rules; therefore PYD may not capture other older years if they are aggregated elsewhere.
